verses.en: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.pt: Filho meu, se ficaste fiador por teu próximo, se deste tua garantia ao estranho;
verses.en_web: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger;
verses.en_bbe: My son, if you have made yourself responsible for your neighbour, or given your word for another,

verses.en: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.pt: Se tu foste capturado pelas palavras de tua própria boca, e te prendeste pelas palavras de tua boca,
verses.en_web: You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: You are taken as in a net by the words of your mouth, the sayings of your lips have overcome you.

verses.en: Do this now, my son, deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
verses.pt: Então faze isto agora, meu filho, e livra-te, pois caíste nas mãos de teu próximo; vai, humilha-te, e insiste exaustivamente ao teu próximo.
verses.en_web: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
verses.en_bbe: Do this, my son, and make yourself free, because you have come into the power of your neighbour; go without waiting, and make a strong request to your neighbour.

verses.en: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.pt: Não dês sono aos teus olhos, nem cochilo às tuas pálpebras.
verses.en_web: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
verses.en_bbe: Give no sleep to your eyes, or rest to them;

verses.en: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.pt: Livra-te, como a corça do caçador, como o pássaro do caçador de aves.
verses.en_web: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
verses.en_bbe: Make yourself free, like the roe from the hand of the archer, and the bird from him who puts a net for her.

verses.en: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.pt: Vai até a formiga, preguiçoso; olha para os caminhos dela, e sê sábio.
verses.en_web: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
verses.en_bbe: Go to the ant, you hater of work; give thought to her ways and be wise:

verses.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.pt: Ela, mesmo não tendo chefe, nem fiscal, nem dominador,
verses.en_web: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
verses.en_bbe: Having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

verses.en: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.pt: Prepara seu alimento no verão, na ceifa ajunta seu mantimento.
verses.en_web: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
verses.en_bbe: She gets her meat in the summer, storing up food at the time of the grain-cutting.

verses.en: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.pt: Ó preguiçoso, até quando estarás deitado? Quando te levantarás de teu sono?
verses.en_web: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
verses.en_bbe: How long will you be sleeping, O hater of work? when will you get up from your sleep?

verses.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.pt: Um pouco de sono, um pouco de cochilo; um pouco de descanso com as mãos cruzadas;
verses.en_web: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.en_bbe: A little sleep, a little rest, a little folding of the hands in sleep:

verses.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.pt: Assim a pobreza virá sobre ti como um assaltante; a necessidade chegará a ti como um homem armado.
verses.en_web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
verses.en_bbe: Then loss will come on you like an outlaw, and your need like an armed man

verses.en: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.pt: O homem mal, o homem injusto, anda com uma boca perversa.
verses.en_web: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth;
verses.en_bbe: A good-for-nothing man is an evil-doer; he goes on his way causing trouble with false words;

verses.en: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.pt: Ele acena com os olhos, fala com seus pés, aponta com seus dedos.
verses.en_web: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers;
verses.en_bbe: Making signs with his eyes, rubbing with his feet, and giving news with his fingers;

verses.en: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
verses.pt: Perversidades há em seu coração; todo o tempo ele trama o mal; anda semeando brigas.
verses.en_web: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
verses.en_bbe: His mind is ever designing evil: he lets loose violent acts.

verses.en: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.pt: Por isso sua perdição virá repentinamente; subitamente ele será quebrado, e não haverá cura.
verses.en_web: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause his downfall will be sudden; quickly he will be broken, and there will be no help for him.

verses.en: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
verses.pt: Estas seis coisas o SENHOR odeia; e sete sua alma abomina:
verses.en_web: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
verses.en_bbe: Six things are hated by the Lord; seven things are disgusting to him:

verses.en: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.pt: Olhos arrogantes, língua mentirosa, e mãos que derramam sangue inocente;
verses.en_web: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood;
verses.en_bbe: Eyes of pride, a false tongue, hands which take life without cause;

verses.en: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.pt: O coração que trama planos malignos, pés que se apressam a correr para o mal;
verses.en_web: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
verses.en_bbe: A heart full of evil designs, feet which are quick in running after sin;

verses.en: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.pt: A falsa testemunha, que sopra mentiras; e o que semeia brigas entre irmãos.
verses.en_web: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
verses.en_bbe: A false witness, breathing out untrue words, and one who lets loose violent acts among brothers.

verses.en: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.pt: Filho meu, guarda o mandamento de teu pai; e não abandones a lei de tua mãe.
verses.en_web: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
verses.en_bbe: My son, keep the rule of your father, and have in memory the teaching of your mother:

verses.en: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
verses.pt: Amarra-os continuamente em teu coração; e pendura-os ao teu pescoço.
verses.en_web: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
verses.en_bbe: Keep them ever folded in your heart, and have them hanging round your neck.

verses.en: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.pt: Quando caminhares, isto te guiará; quando deitares, isto te guardará; quando acordares, isto falará contigo.
verses.en_web: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
verses.en_bbe: In your walking, it will be your guide; when you are sleeping, it will keep watch over you; when you are awake, it will have talk with you.

verses.en: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.pt: Porque o mandamento é uma lâmpada, e a lei é luz; e as repreensões para correção são o caminho da vida;
verses.en_web: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
verses.en_bbe: For the rule is a light, and the teaching a shining light; and the guiding words of training are the way of life.

verses.en: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.pt: Para te protegerem da mulher má, das lisonjas da língua da estranha.
verses.en_web: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
verses.en_bbe: They will keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the strange woman.

verses.en: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.pt: Não cobices a formosura dela em teu coração; nem te prenda em seus olhos.
verses.en_web: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
verses.en_bbe: Let not your heart's desire go after her fair body; let not her eyes take you prisoner.

verses.en: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.pt: Porque pela mulher prostituta chega-se a pedir um pedaço de pão; e a mulher de outro homem anda à caça de uma alma preciosa.
verses.en_web: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
verses.en_bbe: For a loose woman is looking for a cake of bread, but another man's wife goes after one's very life.

verses.en: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.pt: Por acaso pode alguém botar fogo em seu peito, sem que suas roupas se queimem?
verses.en_web: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.en_bbe: May a man take fire to his breast without burning his clothing?

verses.en: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.pt: Ou alguém pode andar sobre as brasas, sem seus pés se arderem?
verses.en_web: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
verses.en_bbe: Or may one go on lighted coals, and his feet not be burned?

verses.en: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.pt: Assim será aquele que se deitar com a mulher de seu próximo; não será considerado inocente todo aquele que a tocar.
verses.en_web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
verses.en_bbe: So it is with him who goes in to his neighbour's wife; he who has anything to do with her will not go free from punishment.

verses.en: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.pt: Não se despreza ao ladrão, quando furta para saciar sua alma, tendo fome;
verses.en_web: Men don’t despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry:
verses.en_bbe: Men do not have a low opinion of a thief who takes food when he is in need of it:

verses.en: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.pt: Mas, se for achado, ele pagará sete vezes mais; ele terá que dar todos os bens de sua casa.
verses.en_web: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
verses.en_bbe: But if he is taken in the act he will have to give back seven times as much, giving up all his property which is in his house.

verses.en: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
verses.pt: Porém aquele que adultera com mulher alheia tem falta de entendimento; quem faz isso destrói sua própria alma.
verses.en_web: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
verses.en_bbe: He who takes another man's wife is without all sense: he who does it is the cause of destruction to his soul.

verses.en: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.pt: Ele encontrará castigo e desgraça; e sua desonra nunca será apagada.
verses.en_web: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
verses.en_bbe: Wounds will be his and loss of honour, and his shame may not be washed away.

verses.en: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.pt: Porque ciúmes são a fúria do marido, e ele de maneira nenhuma terá misericórdia no dia da vingança.
verses.en_web: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.en_bbe: For bitter is the wrath of an angry husband; in the day of punishment he will have no mercy.

verses.en: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.pt: Ele não aceitará nenhum pagamento pela culpa; nem consentirá, ainda que aumentes os presentes.
verses.en_web: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
verses.en_bbe: He will not take any payment; and he will not make peace with you though your money offerings are increased.
